HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)

   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
